scope: Synthetic observation-only invariance test. PICK_TARGET selects the unique identifiable mug; it does not assert executable grasp success. The sensor-layer patch changes no world object or approach geometry.

proposal.description: Apply one opaque sensor-layer patch to the left portion of the SAM-grounded white mug; keep the remaining rim and right-side handle visible. Preserve all pixels outside the patch.
proposal.rationale: Test action-selection invariance under partial observation occlusion.

criteria.requirement: One identifiable, unobstructed white mug is available.
Partial visual occlusion preserves mug identity and the predefined pickup eligibility; no new obstruction of the approach is introduced.
